# LiveReview

Hexmos· LiveReview: Risk-Aware AI Code Review That Scores Every Pull Request and Auto-Approves Low-Risk Changes

Open LiveReview

LiveReview is an AI code review system from Hexmos that gives every pull request a risk score, approves the low-risk ones automatically under a policy you set, and sends the rest to human reviewers with the riskiest code ranked first. It suits engineering teams on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or Azure DevOps whose review queue has become the bottleneck as more code comes from AI assistants.

The Free plan includes 30,000 reviewed lines of code a month for up to 3 team members, with LiveReview's own AI included or your own API keys. Premium is billed by monthly reviewed LOC with unlimited users: $32 for 100K, $64 for 200K, $128 for 400K, $256 for 800K, $512 for 1.6M and $1,024 for 3.2M.
